answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the forge of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, reduced by each unverified claim, rewards vest against future work. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The comet lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the orchard is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short.
